name: Bael
office: He maketh thee to go Invisible.
malice: He appeareth in divers shapes… sometimes all these forms at once.
risk: Requests made invisibly could be mistaken for someone else's or fetch the wrong version of a page.
fn: Fetches other sites' pictures without cookies or referrer, so you pass unseen

name: Agares
office: He maketh them to run that stand still, and bringeth back runaways. He teaches all Languages or Tongues presently.
malice: He hath power also to destroy Dignities… and causeth Earthquakes.
risk: Chasing runaway pages could drag the work off the site you chose.
fn: Brings back runaway pages: tries a lost page's other addresses (http/https, with or without www)

name: Vassago
office: His office is to declare things Past and to Come, and to discover all things Hid or Lost.
risk: Old copies can be wrong or incomplete.
fn: Summons Wayback copies of pages

name: Samigina
office: He teaches all Liberal Sciences, and giveth account of Dead Souls that died in sin.
risk: A living site could be declared dead.
fn: Keeps the register of dead sites

name: Marbas
office: He answereth truly of things Hidden or Secret.
malice: He causeth Diseases and cureth them… and can change men into other shapes.
risk: False testimony could let a disguised file through.
fn: Testifies in the Triangle: names what each file truly is by its first bytes

name: Valefor
office: He is a good Familiar,
malice: but tempteth them he is a familiar of to steal.
risk: Recording could steal your private pages: inboxes, accounts, settings, anything behind a password.
fn: Records the pages you browse on sites you choose

name: Amon
office: He telleth all things Past and to Come. He procureth feuds and reconcileth controversies between friends.
malice: He appeareth like a Wolf… vomiting out of his mouth flames of fire.
risk: A worse copy could overwrite a better one.
fn: Keeps versions of a page and shows the differences between them

name: Barbatos
office: He breaketh the Hidden Treasures open that have been laid by the Enchantments of Magicians.
malice: He… appeareth… with four noble Kings and their companies of great troops.
risk: Text pulled out of scripts could carry code along with it.
fn: Recovers text that old sites hid inside scripts, before the scripts are banished

name: Paimon
office: This Spirit can teach all Arts and Sciences, and other secret things.
malice: He… roareth at his first coming, and his speech is such that the Magician cannot well understand unless he can compel him.
risk: Help that roars and cannot be understood.
fn: Help and Contents, in plain words

name: Buer
office: He healeth all distempers in man, and giveth good Familiars.
risk: Healing by re-fetching could hammer a server.
fn: Archive doctor: finds missing or broken files and fetches them again

name: Gusion
office: He… showeth the meaning and resolution of all questions thou mayest ask.
fn: Search

name: Sitri
office: He… causeth them also to show themselves naked if it be desired.
malice: He enflameth men with Women's love, and Women with Men's love.
risk: A page shown naked still carries its original scripts and trackers.
fn: Keeps each page's original source, as inert text only

name: Beleth
office: He causeth all the love that may be… until the Master Exorcist hath had his desire fulfilled.
malice: He is a mighty King and terrible… very furious at his first appearance.
risk: Pursuing a goal without end; the work never stops.
fn: Completeness: reports how fully a project's goal was fulfilled

name: Leraje
office: He causeth all great Battles and Contests;
malice: and maketh wounds to putrefy that are made with Arrows by Archers.
risk: Failures fester into endless retries.
fn: Keeps the ledger of failed pages until they heal or are given up

name: Eligos
office: He discovereth hidden things, and knoweth things to come; and of Wars, and how the Soldiers will or shall meet.
risk: A forecast taken for a promise.
fn: Estimates how long a running job has left

name: Zepar
office: His office is to cause Women to love Men, and to bring them together in love.
malice: He also maketh them barren.
risk: Links that lead nowhere.
fn: Links related pages (sextile)

name: Botis
office: He telleth all things Past, and to Come, and reconcileth Friends and Foes.
malice: He appeareth at the first show in the form of an ugly Viper… carrying a bright and sharp Sword.
risk: Merging two pages that were not truly one.
fn: Deduplication: one page under two names (conjunction)

name: Bathin
office: He… can transport men suddenly from one country to another.
risk: Carrying you out of the archive's safety onto the live web.
fn: Jumps between the archived, live and Wayback versions of a page

name: Sallos
office: He causeth the Love of Women to Men, and of Men to Women;
fn: Favorites

name: Purson
office: He knoweth all things hidden, and can discover Treasure… and answereth truly of all Earthly things.
malice: carrying a cruel Viper in his hand
risk: Checking leads reaches out to unknown sites.
fn: Checks a lead: is it online, and how much did the archives keep?

name: Marax
office: His office is to make Men very knowing in Astronomy, and all other Liberal Sciences.
fn: Dates each site's era

name: Ipos
office: He knoweth all things Past, Present, and to Come. He maketh men witty and bold.
fn: A page's own timeline: when it existed, its captures, its state now

name: Aim
office: He maketh thee witty in all manner of ways, and giveth true answers unto private matters.
malice: He… carrying a Firebrand in his Hand, wherewith he setteth cities, castles, and great Places, on fire.
risk: Fire destroys a project's progress.
fn: Start Over (clears progress, never files) and the privacy report

name: Naberius
office: He restoreth lost Dignities and Honours.
fn: Restores a page's lost styling from older captures

name: Glasya-Labolas
office: He teacheth all Arts and Sciences in an instant… He can make a Man to go Invisible.
malice: and is an Author of Bloodshed and Manslaughter.
risk: Killing work mid-stride can leave it broken.
fn: Instant stop: kills every task in flight

name: Bune
office: He changeth the Place of the Dead, and causeth the Spirits which be under him to gather together upon your Sepulchres.
risk: A grave dug over a living page: a placeholder overwriting a page you have.
fn: Places markers at dead links: "This page is not in your archive"

name: Ronové
office: He… giveth Good Servants, Knowledge of Tongues.
malice: He appeareth in the Form of a Monster.
risk: More servants, more load on a server.

name: Berith
office: He can give Dignities, and can confirm them unto Man.
malice: He is a Mighty, Great, and Terrible Duke.

name: Astaroth
office: He will declare wittingly how the Spirits fell.
malice: Thou must in no wise let him approach too near unto thee, lest he do thee damage by his Noisome Breath.
risk: Getting too close to dying servers.
fn: A site's decline: when it was last seen alive (asked of the Wayback, at a distance)

name: Forneus
office: He causeth men to have a Good Name, and to have the knowledge and understanding of Tongues.
malice: He… appeareth in the Form of a Great Sea-Monster.
risk: A wrong name sends a page to the wrong place.
fn: Names every page's place in the archive, and reads old text encodings

name: Foras
office: He can discover Treasures and recover things Lost.
risk: Recovery that never gives up.
fn: Runs the four-quarter ladder for lost pages

name: Asmoday
office: He teacheth the Arts of Arithmetic, Astronomy, Geometry… He giveth true and full answers.
malice: If [his cap] be on, Amaymon will deceive him (Goetia). As Asmodeus: "my business is to plot against the newly wedded" (Testament of Solomon).
risk: A scheduler that starves one project or overwhelms one server.
fn: The scheduler: projects take turns in the order of Agrippa's verified squares

name: Gaap
office: He can deliver Familiars out of the Custody of other Magicians.
malice: His Office is to make men Insensible or Ignorant… He can cause Love or Hatred.
risk: Freed familiars arrive unwarded: other tools' archives can hold live scripts.
fn: Imports archives made by other tools (HTTrack, the Onyx archiver)

name: Furfur
office: He giveth True Answers both of Things Secret and Divine, if commanded.
malice: He never speaketh truth unless he be compelled, or brought up within a triangle.
risk: False alarms.
fn: Notifications when a job finishes or needs you (verified facts only)

name: Marchosias
office: He told his Chief… that after 1,200 years he had hopes to return unto the Seventh Throne.
malice: Vomiting Fire out of his mouth.
risk: Resuming from a corrupted memory.
fn: Resumes interrupted work where it stopped

name: Stolas
office: He teacheth the Art of Astronomy.
fn: Draws the Natal Chart

name: Phenex
office: He is a Poet, good and excellent… He hath hopes also to return.
malice: He singeth many sweet notes before the Exorcist, which he must not regard.
risk: Endless revisits lured by sweet notes.
fn: Re-crawls a site later, only when you schedule it

name: Halphas
office: His Office is to build up Towers… and to send Men-of-War to places appointed.
malice: and to furnish them with Ammunition and Weapons
risk: Flooding your disk.
fn: Writes every file to its place in the archive

name: Malphas
office: He can… bring to thy Knowledge Enemies' Desires and Thoughts.
malice: If thou makest a Sacrifice unto him he will receive it kindly and willingly, but he will deceive him that doth it.
risk: Sitemaps lie.
fn: Reads a site's own sitemap, never trusting it blindly

name: Raum
office: His office is to steal Treasures out King's Houses, and to carry it whither he is commanded.
malice: and to destroy Cities and Dignities of Men
risk: Hammering other people's servers for their pictures.
fn: Fetches pictures hotlinked from other hosts

name: Focalor
office: He hath Power over both Winds and Seas; but he will not hurt any man or thing if he be commanded to the contrary.
malice: His office is to slay Men, and to drown them in the Waters, and to overthrow Ships of War.
risk: Overwhelming a server.
fn: Harmonic pacing and courtesy (robots.txt): never hurts a server

name: Vepar
office: His office is to govern the Waters, and to guide Ships laden with Arms.
malice: He maketh men to die in Three Days by Putrefying Wounds… causing Worms to breed in them.
risk: A queue rotting with junk addresses.
fn: The queue: what is fetched next

name: Sabnock
office: His office is to build high Towers, Castles and Cities.
malice: He can afflict Men for many days with Wounds and with Sores rotten and full of Worms.
risk: Bloated pages.
fn: Builds the archive's start page and each site's front page

name: Shax
office: His Office is to take away the Sight, Hearing, or Understanding… He can discover all things that are Hidden.
malice: He must first be commanded into a Triangle… or else he will deceive him, and tell him many Lies.
risk: Taking away too much: real content removed with the embeds.
fn: Turns embedded third-party content and autoplay into plain links

name: Viné
office: His Office is to discover Things Hidden, Witches, Wizards.
malice: He… will… overthrow Great Stone Walls, and make the Waters rough with Storms.
risk: Exposing private people.
fn: Credits each site's authors by the names they used on the site (no email harvesting)

name: Bifrons
office: He changeth Dead Bodies, and putteth them in another place.
malice: also he lighteth seeming Candles upon the Graves of the Dead.
risk: Illusions: false matches.
fn: Recognises sites that moved address; you confirm each match

name: Vual
office: He also procureth Friendship between Friends and Foes.
fn: Maps the friendships between sites (who linked to whom)

name: Haagenti
office: His Office is… to Transmute all Metals into Gold; and to change Wine into Water, and Water into Wine.
risk: A transmutation that cannot be undone.
fn: Turns text and old formats into readable pages, keeping the originals

name: Crocell
office: He warmeth Waters, and discovereth Baths.
malice: He… will produce Great Noises like the Rushings of many Waters, although there be none.
risk: Exposing files never meant to be seen.
fn: Finds open folder listings inside your chosen scope only

name: Furcas
office: His Office is to teach the Arts of Philosophy, Astrology, Rhetoric, Logic.
malice: He… appeareth in the Form of a Cruel Old Man… with a Sharp Weapon in his hand.
fn: Computes the aspects between pages

name: Balam
office: He… giveth True Answers of Things Past, Present, and to Come.
malice: He is a Terrible, Great, and Powerful King… He rideth upon a furious Bear.
risk: A forecast taken for a promise.
fn: Estimates a job's size before it starts

name: Alloces
office: His Office is to teach the Art of Astronomy.
malice: His Speech is hoarse and very big.
fn: Shows the Moon's age

name: Caim
office: His Office is to give unto Men the Understanding of all Birds… and also of the Voice of the Waters.
malice: He seemeth to answer in Burning Ashes, or in Coals of Fire.
risk: Sounds that play by themselves.

name: Murmur
office: His Office is… to constrain Souls Deceased to come before the Exorcist to answer.

name: Orobas
office: He giveth True Answers… of the Creation of the World. He is very faithful unto the Exorcist.
fn: A site's beginning: when it was first seen

name: Gremory
office: His Office is to tell… of Treasures Hid, and what they lie in.

name: Osé
office: His Office is… to change a Man into any Shape… so that he that is so changed will not think any other thing than that he is in verity that Creature.
risk: A copy mistaken for the original.
fn: Saves a plain-text copy of each page, clearly labelled as a copy

name: Amy
office: He… can bewray Treasure that is kept by Spirits.
malice: He… appeareth at first in the Form of a Flaming Fire.
risk: Lures toward dangerous or look-alike sites.
fn: Leads: other sites your archive points to, ranked

name: Orias
office: His Office is to teach the Virtues of the Stars, and to know the Mansions of the Planets.
malice: he holdeth in his Right Hand two Great Serpents hissing
fn: Shows the planetary hour (Greater Key)

name: Vapula
office: His Office is to make Men Knowing in all Handcrafts and Professions.
fn: Settings and the rules editor

name: Zagan
office: He can turn all Metals into Coin of the Dominion that Metal is of.
malice: He can turn… Blood into Wine.
risk: Giving a file the wrong coin.
fn: Gives each file the extension of its true kind

name: Valac
office: His Office is to give True Answers of Hidden Treasures, and to tell where Serpents may be seen.
risk: Leading you to the serpents themselves.

name: Andras
office: His Office is to sow Discords.
malice: If the Exorcist have not a care, he will slay both him and his fellows.
risk: Hostile tests escaping into real sites or your archive.

name: Haures
office: He destroyeth and burneth up those who be the Enemies of the Exorcist… he will not suffer him to be tempted by any other Spirit.
malice: But if he be not commanded into a Triangle, he will Lie in all these Things.
risk: Burning too much while purifying.

name: Andrealphus
office: He maketh Men very subtle… in all Things pertaining unto Mensuration.
malice: appearing at first in the form of a Peacock, with great Noises
fn: Measures sizes and disk use

name: Cimejes
office: His Office is to teach perfectly Grammar, Logic, Rhetoric, and to discover things Lost or Hidden.

name: Amdusias
office: He can cause Trees to bend and incline according to the Exorcist's Will.
malice: causing Trumpets… to be heard, but not soon or immediately
fn: The folding tree of each site

name: Belial
office: His Office is to distribute Presentations and Senatorships.
malice: He… must have Offerings… or else he will not give True Answers… he tarrieth not one hour in the Truth, unless he be constrained by Divine Power.
risk: An export that lies about its contents.

name: Decarabia
office: His Office is… to make the Similitude of all kinds of Birds to fly before the Exorcist.
fn: Image gallery for each site

office: His Office is to go and come… and to carry or recarry anything whither thou wouldest have it to go.
malice: He is of an indifferent Good Nature, and is willing to do anything which the Exorcist desireth.
risk: He will carry anything — including poison.
fn: Fetches pages and files

name: Dantalion
office: He can… show the Similitude of any person, and show the same by a Vision.
malice: he knoweth the Thoughts of all Men and Women, and can change them at his Will
risk: Seeing too much: pictures of private screens.
fn: Thumbnails of pages you record (only on recorded sites, never on private pages)

name: Andromalius
office: His Office is to bring back both a Thief, and the Goods which be stolen; and to discover all Wickedness, and Underhand Dealing.
